title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Program Selection
In March, returning
students
can apply to change their academic
program
online for the following academic
year by using LORIS. If the deadline to change a program has passed or access to the site is not possible,
the online Program Selection Form may be used. Competitive programs require a program transfer form to
request a program change. Program transfer forms are available online in March and are typically due by
May 1st. Visit the
Making Changes to your Undergraduate Program
website for further information and
forms.
To change a program for a given
term
, the change must be made before the last business day before the
first day of regularly scheduled classes of that term.
